title: Anemll (@anemll) on X
excerpt: Confirmed 24K context on iPhone with both K/V on int8. Delta net stays FP16. Decoding also peaks at 70 tok/s with easy to predict context. Apple Neural Engine on A20 is fast 🚀

Qwen 3.8- 27B on iPhone 18 Apple Neural Engine. Added draft model , dflash-2 at ~ 2.8 bpw ( mixed 2-4 vector quantization with small drop in acceptance rate) Base is @PrismML Bonsai-2, 1.585 bpw requantized to 1.5 bpw ( VQ 6 bits per 4 weights) Decoding speed is 15-60 tps.
